root_text: Malaysia saw 327 cases of HMPV infection in 2024 – a 45 per cent rise from 225 cases in 2023. WHO does not view HMPV in China as an emergency. Rise in HMPV cases in S’pore typical during year-end period, precautions still need to be taken.
